description: Re-orders the channels of a polyphonic signal on a trigger, by shuffling them or rotating them one place

inputs.text: The polyphonic signal whose channels are re-ordered, and whose channel count the output takes
A rising edge re-orders the channels by the mode picked on the menu
A rising edge puts the channels back into the order they arrive in

outputs.text: The input's channels in their current order

menu: shuffle — makes a trigger re-order the channels at random
rotate up — makes a trigger move every channel up one place
rotate down — makes a trigger move every channel down one place
